question:
DRAG DROP -
Refer to the exhibit. Drag and drop FCoE port types from the right onto the corresponding positions on the left to complete the FCoE deployment. Port types can be used more than once. Not all port types are used.
context: Topology: FCF NPIV Core switch connects down to FCOE NPV switch, which connects down to FCOE Host.
theory: In an FCoE topology, the FCF's virtual ports facing the FCoE NPV bridge and the FCoE host are both VF_Ports, the FCoE equivalent of a native F port on a fabric switch, because the FCF always presents a fabric-side port to whatever connects to it; the FCoE NPV bridge presents a VNP_Port toward the core, mirroring how a native NP port presents itself as a host to its upstream, and the FCoE host presents a VN_Port, mirroring a native N port, toward the NPV bridge. Matching these virtual port types to their native FC equivalents is the core exam concept. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 9 - FCoE Port Types)
